$comment: Fixtures the Skor Kahini agent will trade and the score attestor will attest. The eventKey each market is keyed by is DERIVED from these fields (see agents/src/agents/score-oracle/consensus.ts, canonicalFixtureString) rather than assigned, so anyone can recompute it and check that a market points at the fixture it claims to.

fixtures.question: Arsenal vs Chelsea (Premier League, 2026-09-06): will Arsenal win? Settled by agreement between independent public score APIs; if they disagree the market voids and everyone is refunded.
Everton vs Manchester United (Premier League, 2026-09-06): will the match finish with 3 or more total goals? Settled by agreement between independent public score APIs.
